name: Shukaku
description: (Tag:beast)(Tag:character)(Tag:earth)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:spirit)The One-Tail, a massive beast made entirely of sand and resistant to physical blows. It creates and controls sand, wind, and magnetism, supplemented by sealing techniques. As a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.
